title: Special Topics in Higher Education and Student Affairs; College Student Governance and Involvement
department: Higher Ed, Student Affairs, and International Ed Policy
description: For many students in higher education, co-curricular experiences may be political, governmental, religious, cultural and identity- based, social and community-based, or academic in nature. From organizations as involvement to governing in campus-level and elected leadership capacities, individuals in this graduate course will explore student involvement and governance in the higher education and student affairs context.
